calibration_question: At fixed total scheduled demand and fixed departure times, does increasing the share of trips passing through the already selected disruption direction produce a measurable but non-catastrophic fixed-time baseline disturbance?

research_boundary.priority: Reduce empirical uncertainty efficiently; no apparatus expansion or positive-result guarantee.

scientific_configuration.restriction_restoration: Restore the exact pre-activation permissions at t=600; observe both transitions directly.
scientific_configuration.tls: Exact original network-embedded static programs, phases, durations, offsets and links; no signal-control intervention.
scientific_configuration.allowed_input_change: Only per-vehicle route IDs according to this allocation; future output paths/input file references may be operationally rebound.
scientific_configuration.lane_loss_interpretation: One passenger lane unavailable; do not claim an exact physical link-capacity fraction.

source_bindings.old_observer_byte_exact_reuse_rule_scope: Applies to executed uniform V1 evidence; not imposed on the separately versioned, not-yet-implemented cutoff-aware successor.
source_bindings.historical_counts_warning: Original disruption specification counts describe 1X only. Use this contract's per-level planned counts, never historical 15/180 as new-level counts or actual observed exposure.

concentration.definition: Number of scheduled trips assigned to row1_east divided by 540.
concentration.opposite_route_rule: Ordinary member of the eleven residual routes; no automatic increase.

allocation.canonical_order_source: Frozen original route XML document order; remove row1_east to obtain residual order.
allocation.rng: Python 3.12.14 standard-library random.Random(seed), isolated from simulator/global RNG; alternate implementation/runtime must match all frozen logical assignment digests.
allocation.permutation_rule: For each seed initialize exactly one fresh local RNG. For b=0..14 make a fresh p=list(range(36)); call rng.shuffle(p) once; retain p. Exactly 15 shuffles, no intervening or additional random draws. Reuse these same permutations for all levels; do not advance RNG across levels.
allocation.assignment_rule: For each seed and level reset residual counter j=0 once. Set m=target_route_trips/15. For blocks b=0..14 and permutation ranks r=0..35, let k=p_b[r]. If r<m, assign row1_east to slot k. Otherwise assign residual_route_order[j mod 11] to slot k and increment j. Do not reset j at a block boundary. Emit records in chronological (b,k) order.
allocation.rounding_rule: Let (q,r)=divmod(540-target_route_trips,11). The first r routes in the fixed residual order receive q+1 trips; the rest receive q. Within each block, counts among the eleven residual routes differ by at most one through the same continuous cyclic allocation.
allocation.target_block_balance: Exactly target_route_trips/15 in every block; no rounding needed for the declared ladder.
allocation.pair_invariant: Materialize one immutable demand per seed/level and reuse identical bytes for N0/D0; equal IDs must have identical scheduled departure, route and vehicle attributes within the pair.
allocation.across_level_boundary: IDs and aggregate departure vector are equal, but route assignments intentionally differ; these are not identical OD trip populations.
allocation.temporal_boundary: Preserve aggregate departure schedule exactly. Route-specific assignments/departure vectors change only as specified by concentration; no added bursts or time shifts.
allocation.scheduled_vs_observed_exposure: Target departures scheduled in [300,600) are 30/45/60/90, not actual A1B1 event-period entries. Qualification requires observed entries.

primary_accounting_clarification.restricted_time: min(valid_non_teleported_arrival,H)-scheduled_departure; if no valid arrival, H-scheduled_departure, including active and undeparted.
primary_accounting_clarification.full_horizon_queue_samples: One sample at every integer step endpoint 1 through 1500; never stop merely because demand has ended.

qualification_contract.event_entry_semantics: A unique passenger edge visit whose one-second entry transition interval overlaps [300,600): interval_end>300 and interval_start<600. Preexisting occupants are not entries.

local_physical_response.criterion: At least one directly exposed vehicle has increased A1B1 time, positive additional A1B1 halting, or delayed final arrival in D0 versus N0.
local_physical_response.missing_or_ambiguous_pairing_rule: If no positive witness exists and any potentially decisive visit or arrival comparison is missing or ambiguous, the local gate is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE. A positive edge-time, edge-halting, or valid-arrival witness passes even when another comparison is unavailable.
local_physical_response.pairing: Pair each D0 event-entry vehicle to its unique A1B1 visit in D0 and unique A1B1 traversal in matched N0; fixed routes contain A1B1 at most once. Any multiple-visit ambiguity is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.

qualification_contract.seed_pair_state_rule: INTEGRITY_FAILURE if integrity is contradicted; otherwise DOES_NOT_QUALIFY if any scientific gate definitively fails; otherwise NOT_IDENTIFIABLE if any required gate is unknown; otherwise QUALIFIES.

qualification_clarifications.d0_exposure_unit: Unique passenger event-entry vehicles under inherited entry-interval semantics, not scheduled trips, preexisting occupants or repeated-entry event totals.
qualification_clarifications.pilot_threshold_status: Inherited pilot sensitivity heuristics, not theoretical thresholds and not dissertation delta.
qualification_clarifications.possible_inadequacy: Local disruption effects may be diluted in all-network metrics; record any resulting rejection for review without changing the +1 second or +5 percent rules.
qualification_clarifications.censoring_rule_location: measurement_prerequisites.successor_requirements; missing/ambiguous comparisons retain inherited NOT_IDENTIFIABLE semantics.

selection_rule.level_state_rule: A level QUALIFIES only when all three seed pairs QUALIFY. Any definitive seed nonqualification makes the level DOES_NOT_QUALIFY even if a different seed is NOT_IDENTIFIABLE. With no definitive failure, any NOT_IDENTIFIABLE seed stops selection as INCONCLUSIVE.
selection_rule.integrity_or_technical_failure: Stop separately; no automatic scientific substitutions or retries. Record the failed attempt and gate.
selection_rule.repeat_failure_rule: Stop; do not proceed to higher concentrations or treat a failed repeat as permission to search onward.
selection_rule.no_qualifying_required_action: Report for review; do not add levels, lower thresholds, change total demand, move or strengthen incident.
selection_rule.no_qualifying_requires: All four levels definitively fail qualification without integrity defects or unresolved selection ambiguity.

future_status_contract.FAIL: Executed input, implementation, integrity, public-repository, or freeze/readback contradiction.
future_status_contract.BLOCKED: The local environment prevents a required run or durable write without a scientific contradiction.
future_status_contract.INCONCLUSIVE: A required selection decision remains semantically ambiguous after otherwise trustworthy evidence.
future_status_contract.NO_QUALIFYING_OD_CONCENTRATION: All four declared concentrations definitively do not qualify with trustworthy evidence.
future_status_contract.PASS: The first qualifier passes all three seeds, exact repeat, and freeze readback.

existing_behavior.primary_ledger: Active and undeparted trips retain H-scheduled departure; all scheduled IDs remain in terminal accounting and denominators.
existing_behavior.active_off_monitored_edge: Primary accounting supported; observer can finalize if no monitored visits remain open.
existing_behavior.active_on_monitored_edge: Observer finalize rejects remaining vehicles/open edge or lane visits; wrapper makes calibration inconclusive before final exposure payload.
existing_behavior.open_visits: No explicit right-censored representation; summaries consume closed visit collections.
existing_behavior.local_pairing: Reader subtracts numeric visit durations/halting without a censoring contract.
existing_behavior.preexisting_occupancy: Distinguished from new entries; continued occupancy alone is not a post-activation entry.
existing_behavior.restricted_lane_reentry: A new restricted-lane visit during restriction is counted even if that vehicle was present before activation.
existing_behavior.native_waiting: The zero-undeparted rule exists, but source sums supplied tripinfo waitingTime without category normalization. Undeparted/sentinel behavior remains an unverified static case, not an observed simulator defect.

successor_requirements: Create only a minimal separately versioned measurement successor and OD input adapter after new authorization; preserve all historical observer, runner, contracts and evidence unchanged.

At H finalize observation coverage, not the physical trip. Record still-open edge/lane visits as RIGHT_CENSORED_AT_H with real observed entry interval, ID/lane/visit occurrence, observation endpoint H, last sampled time/state, observed duration lower bound H-entry_observed, and observed halting through H.
Keep genuine exit fields null for open visits. Never fabricate EXIT_EDGE, EXIT_LANE, WAIT_END, completed traversal or arrival. Preserve one-second interval uncertainty.
Include open/censored records in per-vehicle summary, event-entry exposure and lane-entry compliance. Preserve preexisting-occupant versus new-entry distinctions, including re-entry.

Local point witnesses may use uniquely paired completed observed traversal duration/halting or genuine valid-arrival pairs only. Arrival witnesses retain the inherited unique D0 event-entry visit and unique matched N0 traversal eligibility; they cannot bypass pairing. Retain censored observations descriptively and never subtract lower bounds as completed durations. Without an eligible positive witness, any potentially decisive censored/missing/ambiguous comparison yields NOT_IDENTIFIABLE.
Preserve positive-witness precedence and definite-scientific-failure versus unknown status precedence; a legitimate unfinished trip alone is not a software-integrity failure.

Normalize genuinely undeparted native waiting to zero only for recognized undeparted null/sentinel/zero representations, retaining raw fields. Contradictory positive/invalid records fail validation rather than silently normalize. Require complete valid departed coverage. Validate sentinel handling synthetically; do not assert behavior from unrun SUMO.
Preserve all-540 primary mean/P95 and disjoint accounting, full-H queue trace, unchanged qualification thresholds, activation/restoration and deterministic normalized readback.
Bind the separate future observer/adapter version and input/configuration hashes before any execution. Any run authorization is a separate gate.

Using only completed point comparisons or eligible genuine arrivals is a predeclared conservative observability policy: censored lower-bound observations are not witnesses under this version, even if suggestive. NOT_IDENTIFIABLE is not proof of no physical response.
future_offline_fixture_requirements: all 3 seeds x 4 levels: exact schedule, route totals, block totals, nesting, pair identity and digests
active outside monitored edge and active on monitored edge at H
scheduled but undeparted trip, native waiting null/sentinel/valid zero handling
open edge/lane visits, open halting interval and right-censored record fields
one or both visits censored; unavailable final arrival; no false point-duration differences
positive completed witness with another unknown; definite scientific failure with unknown local response
preexisting lane occupant, continued occupancy, departure and re-entry
all-scheduled terminal partition, finite metrics and unchanged thresholds
deterministic serialization/readback and passive observer noninterference
completed-visit event, sampled-duration and halting parity with V1, normalizing version identity only

diagnostics.actual_event_period_exposure: Observed unique D0 passenger entry vehicles, event-entry transitions, planned structural target count and exposure-status completeness separately.
diagnostics.compliance: Pre-activation lane occupant snapshot; occupancy while restriction active; post-activation restricted-lane entry visits including re-entry. A persistent occupant is not a new-entry violation.
diagnostics.local_edge_time_and_halting: Per-vehicle visit observations/statuses, completed point differences where eligible and censored lower bounds otherwise.
diagnostics.network_signed_excess_queue: Full D0_QUEUE(t)-N0_QUEUE(t), including negative values; no clipping in signed trace or qualification queue burden.
diagnostics.completion_and_unfinished: All five terminal categories and counts over all540; preserve undeparted insertion burden.
diagnostics.restricted_trip_time_differences: Within-pair D0-N0 per scheduled ID, plus all-scheduled mean/P95; do not substitute completed-only metrics.

post_restoration_behavior.decline_rule: At least one later post-restoration sample is below the earliest maximum positive excess queue.
post_restoration_behavior.near_zero_rule: After the earliest positive peak and a strict decline, positive excess queue is <=1 at some sample strictly before H_PILOT.

diagnostics.cohort_boundary: D0-selected exposure cohort is descriptive, not an unbiased population for final causal treatment estimation.
diagnostics.capacity_boundary: Observed edge entries/throughput are realized flow, not physical link capacity.

future_execution_budget.technical_attempts: Record separately with failures, exclusions and unfinished state; do not use technical labels to evade bounds or authorize parameter changes/retries.

interpretation_boundary.establishes_only: Whether a frozen physical disruption produces enough measurable fixed-time baseline traffic response for later method comparisons.

offline_validation.method: Pure in-memory standard-library arithmetic/XML/JSON inspection; no repository source imports or execution, no tests and no simulator.
checks: unique directed target route and unchanged twelve geometries verified from frozen XML
all eight published frozen-input hashes verified
original 3X inputs independently reconstructed in memory and matched all three published XML hashes
540 unique IDs and original departure-time vectors preserved for all seeds and levels
all per-route totals and per-block target totals exact; all routes present per block; residual floor/ceiling balance
nested C1-C4 target ID sets and identical logical N0/D0 assignments
qualification, metric, repeat and recovery objects inherited unchanged; internal schema/types/bounds and source-binding readback passed
offline_validation.digest_encoding: SHA256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=True,separators=(',',':')), no trailing newline. Chronological rows: schedule=[vehicle_id,integer_departure]; assignment=[vehicle_id,integer_departure,route_id].

next_task.scope: One bounded, separately versioned OD allocation/input and cutoff-aware measurement adapter with synthetic offline validation only. Preserve historical files; no SUMO, TraCI or experiments. Obtain fresh authorization first.
